import parse

# Comprehensive R1 tests (trailing newlines)
print('=== R1: Trailing Newline Tests ===')
cases = [
    # (format, string, expected_result_type)
    ('hello', 'hello\n', 'match'),
    ('hello', 'hello', 'match'),
    ('hello', 'hello\n\n', 'no_match'),  # two newlines don't match
    ('hello {}', 'hello world\n', 'match'),
    ('{:d}', '42\n', 'match'),
    ('{name:w}', 'hello\n', 'match'),
    ('{0:d}', '42\n', 'match'),
    ('hello\n', 'hello\n', 'match'),
]

for fmt, s, expected in cases:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    status = 'match' if r is not None else 'no_match'
    ok = 'OK' if status == expected else 'FAIL'
    print(f'  {ok}: {fmt!r} on {s!r} -> {status} (expected {expected})')

print()
print('=== R2: Digit Field Numbering Tests ===')
cases2 = [
    ('{0:d}', '42', 42),
    ('{0:f}', '3.14', 3.14),
    ('{0:x}', 'ff', 255),
    ('{0:o}', '77', 63),
    ('{0:b}', '1010', 10),
    ('{0:w}', 'hello', 'hello'),
    ('{0:>10}', '      hello', '     hello'),
    ('{0:.>10}', '.....hello', '.....hello'),
    ('{0:05d}', '00042', 42),
    ('{0:w} {1:d}', 'hello 42', ('hello', 42)),
]

for fmt, s, expected in cases2:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    if r is None:
        print(f'  FAIL: {fmt!r} on {s!r} -> None')
    elif isinstance(expected, tuple):
        ok = 'OK' if r.fixed == expected else 'FAIL'
        print(f'  {ok}: {fmt!r} on {s!r} -> {r.fixed} (expected {expected})')
    else:
        ok = 'OK' if r.fixed[0] == expected else 'FAIL'
        print(f'  {ok}: {fmt!r} on {s!r} -> {r.fixed[0]} (expected {expected})')
"
